answer: Each payout address may originate only one IPv6 /48 and ASN; reuse is refused. After the seed, that prefix originates a seed-embedding community at whisper priority (low local-pref) that a public route-server bridge logs. The receipt must match the keepalive-timing ripple from first session, so a borrowed port fails. One prefix presents one origin before cutoff, so each fake identity needs its own allocation and uplink. Assumed fees: $400/year per prefix and $90/month per uplink; 100 extras run about $40,000 a year plus $9,000 that month.
